item.title: The State of Sex Ed in America
item.description: According to data from The Tylt, 77 percent of readers believe sex ed in schools is ineffective. item.title: Michael Love Michael will change how you think about pop music
item.description: Michael Love Michael has been busy during quarantine: the EP they'd been working on became a full album, XO. They sat down to tell us all about the music that inspired them growing up, where the name Michael Love Michael comes from and what being creative means to them as a queer Black person. Plus, if they'll ever perform again, how they nourish their spirit and a special Fire Off on '90s music! item.title: Q&A: With musical artist Michael Love Michael
item.description: Socially conscience artists don't show up everyday but Michael Love Michael is standing on the right side of history. The singer and songwriter is using their platform to elevate marginalized voices and to promote healing oneself. Michael sat down with The Tylt to discuss their upcoming album, how they decided on their stage name, and their latest single, "JFC" which celebrates Black voices and freedom. Catch it all below.

item.title: Nina West shares her rise to 'RuPaul's Drag Race' superstardom
item.description: Season 11’s Miss Congeniality, Nina West, 42, auditioned nine times to be on the show before she made it on and slayed the 2019 season. On this episode of Fiercely Fandom with Deron., host Deron Dalton has a kiki with West about the ins and outs of "RuPaul's Drag Race," how the popular show changes the lives of the queens on it and nevertheless, the challenges drag queens are facing. item.title: Clothespin Communications: Gen Z and Millennials pine for human interaction in digital landscapes.
item.description: Society is always in forward motion. Each new decade brings improvements across multiple facets of life, from medicine to standards of living, education to opportunities. That said, for every two steps forward is one step back. For Gen Z and Millennials in particular, with every advancement in technology comes a setback in Clothespin Communications.
